$comment: Editable pain-signal library for the ideal customer. Each post must name at least one pain signal or dream signal.

signals.text: leads wait hours for a response
signals.buyerSituation: inbound leads arrive faster than the team can answer them

signals.text: staff manually copy information between tools
signals.buyerSituation: two systems of record and a person in the middle
an assistant that saves less time than it costs to review

signals.text: retries create duplicate actions or surprise bills
signals.buyerSituation: a retry that re-sends the email or re-charges the card

signals.text: nobody can explain why an automation failed
signals.buyerSituation: a silent failure discovered days later by a customer

signals.text: the workflow works in a demo but breaks in production
signals.buyerSituation: a pilot that never survived real volume

signals.text: the founder is the only person who knows how the process works
signals.buyerSituation: a process that stops when one person is on a plane

signals.text: automation has no state or recovery path
signals.buyerSituation: a run that dies halfway and cannot be resumed
